nodes.title: Input_Positive
widgets_values: medium rear shot of a knight holding a sword on his shoulder, the camera orbits around into a close-up of his face as he says, "I had enough". He looks determined and has a little bit of blood coming out of his mouth. The location is a mediaeval battlefield. The style is cinematic and dark.  Background sound is a huge battle happening: clinking swords, man screaming, the sound of the wind and thunder.
